recorded_native_waits.limitation: Biased retained samples: whole-step wall time >2ms or tick divisible by 250. Counts/medians are not population rates; unpaired boundary intervals remain unaccounted. AP-only waits do not identify an AP function, thread, or host cause.

timings.limitation: Thread CPU separates execution from off-CPU time; off-CPU includes I/O wait and descheduling

native_waits.limitation: Supervisor blocking/runnable time does not identify the native FC or host cause

rate.limitation: Replays captured boundary timestamps through real JointRate, not underlying workload or OS scheduling. Release delay includes caller work, pacing and scheduling; it does not identify their cause.

limits: Printed trace timestamps have microsecond precision.
Boundary half-events are excluded; missing wakeups remain unknown.
FC comm-to-kernel-TID correlation is diagnostic and inherits the mapping limitation.
FC scheduler overlap with a supervisor wait is temporal co-occurrence, not causation.
Guest scheduler states do not identify a Windows or physical storage cause.
